---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill for the library
title: "skill: <name>"
labels: skill-proposal
---

**The trigger** — the real moment a design team reaches for this. What's in their hands,
what are they asking for?

**The gate** — what does this skill refuse to do, and on what missing input? (A skill with
no refusal condition is a utility, not a unit of judgment — see CONTRIBUTING.md.)

**The output shape** — what does it hand back when the gate passes?

**Which gate does it serve?** Intent / Decision / Value / routing / team-level — and what
existing skill's output feeds it, if any?
